issues.name: Crystal Methamphetamine
issues.description: A highly addictive stimulant that causes rapid dopamine release, leading to severe physical and psychological dependence, dental decay, skin lesions, and paranoid psychosis.

issues.name: Cocaine & Crack Cocaine
issues.description: A powerful stimulant that produces intense euphoria, increased energy, and heightened alertness. Regular use leads to cardiovascular damage, nasal perforation, and severe psychological dependence.

issues.name: Khat / Mairungi
issues.description: A stimulant plant chewed for its euphoric and energizing effects. Long-term use causes dental decay, insomnia, digestive issues, and financial strain.

issues.name: Energy Drinks & High-Caffeine Products
issues.description: High-caffeine beverages consumed for energy and alertness. Overuse leads to anxiety, heart palpitations, sleep disruption, and caffeine dependence.

issues.name: Heroin & Street-Cut Opiates
issues.description: A highly addictive opioid that produces intense euphoria and pain relief. Street versions often contain toxic cutting agents. Withdrawal is severe and requires medical supervision.

issues.name: Prescription Cough Syrups
issues.slang: Bronco / Broncleer / Codeine / Lean / Dirty Sprite
issues.description: Codeine-based cough syrups consumed recreationally. Physical dependence develops quickly. Withdrawal causes restless legs, stomach cramps, and extreme anxiety.

issues.name: Sedatives & Dissociatives
issues.description: Central nervous system depressants used for anxiety or recreation. Abrupt cessation can cause life-threatening seizures. Requires medical tapering.

issues.name: Inhalants & Industrial Solvents
issues.description: Volatile substances inhaled for intoxication. Causes severe neurological damage, organ failure, and sudden death. Particularly prevalent among street-connected youth.

issues.name: Alcohol & Illicit Spirits
issues.description: A widely available depressant. Chronic use causes liver disease, neurological damage, and severe withdrawal. Illicit brews carry additional methanol poisoning risks.

issues.name: Cannabis / Mbanje / Skunk
issues.description: A psychoactive plant used for relaxation and euphoria. High-potency strains increase risk of anxiety, paranoia, and motivation loss. Legal status in Zimbabwe is decriminalized for personal use.

issues.name: Vaping & E-Cigarettes
issues.description: Electronic nicotine delivery systems. Often perceived as safer than tobacco but carries respiratory risks and high nicotine dependence potential.

issues.name: Combustible Tobacco, Shisha & Snuff
issues.description: Traditional tobacco products. Leading cause of preventable death globally. Shisha use carries additional risks of infectious disease transmission.

issues.name: Psychedelics
issues.description: Hallucinogenic substances that alter perception and cognition. Risk of persistent perceptual changes (HPPD) and triggering latent mental health conditions.

issues.name: Ultra-Processed Foods & High-Sugar
issues.description: Highly palatable foods engineered to trigger dopamine release. Associated with obesity, metabolic disorders, and addictive eating patterns affecting all age groups.

issues.name: OTCs & Lifestyle Supplements
issues.description: Over-the-counter medications and supplements used outside therapeutic guidelines. Includes codeine-based painkillers, stimulant pills, and anabolic steroids.

issues.name: Social Media Algorithms
issues.description: Platforms engineered to maximize user engagement through variable reward schedules. Drives compulsive scrolling, social comparison, and attention fragmentation.

issues.name: Algorithmic Rage-Bait & Outrage Farming
issues.description: Content designed to provoke strong emotional responses, increasing engagement at the cost of mental well-being and social cohesion.

issues.name: Online Gaming & Microtransactions
issues.description: Digital games designed with psychological hooks to maximize time and money spent. Includes gambling-like mechanics in games accessible to minors.

issues.name: Pornography & Hyper-Sexualized Media
issues.description: Explicit media that can alter sexual expectations, intimacy patterns, and self-image. May escalate to compulsive use patterns with significant relational impact.

issues.name: Dating & Hookup Apps
issues.description: Platforms gamifying romantic connections, often leading to validation-seeking, shallow interactions, and reduced capacity for real-world intimacy.

issues.name: Impulse E-Commerce & Haul Culture
issues.description: Online shopping platforms designed for frictionless purchasing. Drives compulsive buying, financial strain, and environmental waste.

issues.name: Gambling & Sports Betting
issues.description: Digital betting platforms with variable reward schedules. Can rapidly lead to severe financial losses, debt, and family breakdown. Often targets low-income communities.

issues.name: Forex & Crypto Trading Schemes
issues.description: High-risk speculative trading often marketed as wealth-building. Many schemes are fraudulent, leading to significant financial loss and psychological distress.

issues.name: Television & Scripted Reality Bingeing
issues.description: Passive consumption of television content, often reality or scripted drama. Contributes to sedentary lifestyle, social isolation, and distorted perception of relationships.

issues.name: Radio & Commercial Advertising Loops
issues.description: Repetitive advertising that conditions consumer behavior, often promoting alcohol, gambling, and unhealthy products.

issues.name: Music as Behavioral Conditioning
issues.description: Music content that normalizes substance use, violence, and materialism, particularly influential among youth and young adults.

issues.name: Major Depressive Disorder
issues.description: A mood disorder characterized by persistent sadness, loss of interest, fatigue, and changes in sleep and appetite. Often co-occurs with substance use.

issues.name: Bipolar Disorder (Type I & II)
issues.description: A mood disorder with alternating episodes of depression and mania/hypomania. Requires ongoing management with medication and lifestyle stability.

issues.name: Persistent Depressive Disorder (Dysthymia)
issues.description: A chronic, low-grade depression lasting at least two years. Often overlooked but significantly impairs quality of life.

issues.name: Seasonal Affective Disorder (SAD)
issues.description: Depression that occurs seasonally, typically in winter months. Linked to reduced sunlight exposure and circadian disruption.

issues.name: Generalized Anxiety Disorder
issues.description: Excessive, uncontrollable worry about everyday life events. Associated with physical symptoms like palpitations, tension, and sleep disturbance.

issues.name: Social Anxiety Disorder
issues.description: Intense fear of social situations and negative evaluation. Leads to avoidance that impacts education, employment, and relationships.

issues.name: Panic Disorder & Panic Attacks
issues.description: Recurrent, unexpected panic attacks accompanied by fear of future attacks. Physical symptoms include heart palpitations, shortness of breath, and dizziness.

issues.name: Specific Phobias
issues.description: Intense, irrational fear of specific objects or situations (e.g., heights, animals, blood). Causes significant avoidance behavior.

issues.name: Agoraphobia
issues.description: Fear of situations where escape might be difficult or help unavailable. Often leads to severe restriction of activities and social isolation.

issues.name: Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)
issues.description: A disorder triggered by exposure to traumatic events. Symptoms include flashbacks, hypervigilance, avoidance, and emotional numbing.

issues.name: Complex PTSD (C-PTSD)
issues.description: A related condition resulting from prolonged, repeated trauma, often in childhood. Involves affect dysregulation, negative self-concept, and interpersonal difficulties.

issues.name: Acute Stress Disorder
issues.description: An intense stress response occurring within one month of a traumatic event. May develop into PTSD if unresolved.

issues.name: Adjustment Disorder
issues.description: A stress response to a specific life change or event (e.g., divorce, job loss). Symptoms include anxiety, depression, and behavioral changes.

issues.name: Grief and Bereavement
issues.description: The psychological response to loss. May become complicated when grief is prolonged or interferes with daily functioning.

issues.name: Non-Suicidal Self-Injury (NSSI)
issues.description: Self-inflicted harm without suicidal intent, often as an emotional regulation strategy. Requires compassionate intervention and distress tolerance skills.

issues.name: Suicidal Ideation
issues.description: Thoughts of ending one's life. Requires immediate, non-judgmental assessment and professional intervention.

issues.name: Suicide Attempt Recovery
issues.description: Ongoing support following a suicide attempt. Requires comprehensive mental health care, safety planning, and family involvement.

issues.name: Anorexia Nervosa
issues.description: Characterized by severe restriction of food intake, intense fear of weight gain, and distorted body image. Can be life-threatening.

issues.name: Bulimia Nervosa
issues.description: Episodes of binge eating followed by purging behaviors. Associated with medical complications including electrolyte imbalances.

issues.name: Binge Eating Disorder
issues.description: Recurrent episodes of eating large quantities of food with loss of control, without purging. Associated with distress and obesity.

issues.name: ARFID (Avoidant/Restrictive Food Intake Disorder)
issues.description: Eating disorder characterized by limited food intake based on sensory sensitivity or fear of consequences, without body image disturbance.

issues.name: Orthorexia Nervosa
issues.description: An obsession with healthy eating that becomes restrictive and interferes with daily life. Often overlooked in wellness culture.

issues.name: ADHD (Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder)
issues.description: A neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by inattention, hyperactivity, and impulsivity. Often undiagnosed in adults.

issues.name: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)
issues.description: A lifelong neurodevelopmental condition affecting social communication, behavior, and sensory processing. Often requires tailored support.

issues.name: Learning Disorders (Dyslexia, Dyscalculia)
issues.description: Specific learning difficulties affecting reading (dyslexia) or math (dyscalculia). Often lead to academic frustration and low self-esteem.

issues.name: Intellectual Disability
issues.description: A condition with limitations in intellectual functioning and adaptive behavior. Requires tailored support across life domains.

issues.name: Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD)
issues.description: Characterized by intrusive thoughts (obsessions) and repetitive behaviors (compulsions). Causes significant distress and impairment.

issues.name: Body Dysmorphic Disorder (BDD)
issues.description: Preoccupation with perceived flaws in physical appearance. Often leads to excessive mirror-checking, cosmetic procedures, and social avoidance.

issues.name: Hoarding Disorder
issues.description: Persistent difficulty discarding possessions, leading to accumulation that compromises living spaces and daily functioning.

issues.name: Trichotillomania (Hair Pulling)
issues.description: A body-focused repetitive behavior involving recurrent hair pulling. Often used as a stress-reduction mechanism.

issues.name: Excoriation Disorder (Skin Picking)
issues.description: Recurrent skin picking resulting in lesions. Associated with significant distress and social embarrassment.

issues.name: Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD)
issues.description: A condition with unstable moods, relationships, and self-image. Intense fear of abandonment and difficulty regulating emotions.

issues.name: Narcissistic Personality Disorder (NPD)
issues.description: A pattern of grandiosity, need for admiration, and lack of empathy. Often coexists with substance use or other mental health conditions.

issues.name: Antisocial Personality Disorder
issues.description: A disregard for others' rights, lack of remorse, and manipulative behavior. Often intersects with criminal justice system involvement.

issues.name: Avoidant Personality Disorder
issues.description: A pattern of social inhibition, feelings of inadequacy, and hypersensitivity to criticism. Results in significant social isolation.

issues.name: Schizophrenia
issues.description: A severe mental disorder with symptoms including hallucinations, delusions, disorganized thinking, and impaired daily functioning.

issues.name: Schizoaffective Disorder
issues.description: A condition with features of both schizophrenia and a mood disorder (depression or bipolar). Requires both psychiatric and mood management.

issues.name: Brief Psychotic Disorder
issues.description: Sudden, short-lived psychotic episodes often triggered by extreme stress. Usually resolves within one month.

issues.name: Substance-Induced Psychosis
issues.description: Psychotic symptoms directly caused by substance use or withdrawal. Often resolves with cessation but may persist in vulnerable individuals.

issues.name: Somatic Symptom Disorder
issues.description: Distress about physical symptoms that are disproportionate to any underlying medical condition. Significant healthcare seeking and functional impairment.

issues.name: Dissociative Identity Disorder (DID)
issues.description: Disruption of identity with two or more distinct personality states. Often develops in response to severe trauma in childhood.

issues.name: Depersonalization / Derealization Disorder
issues.description: Persistent feelings of unreality, detachment from self (depersonalization) or surroundings (derealization). Can be chronic and distressing.

issues.name: Insomnia Disorder
issues.description: Difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or early morning waking. Affects mood, cognition, and physical health.

issues.name: Hypersomnia
issues.description: Excessive daytime sleepiness or prolonged nighttime sleep. Can be primary or secondary to depression, substance use, or medical conditions.

issues.name: Delayed Sleep Phase Disorder
issues.description: A sleep disorder where the circadian rhythm is delayed, leading to difficulty sleeping at conventional times. Often affects adolescents and young adults.

issues.name: Academic Stress Disorder
issues.description: Severe stress related to academic performance, including exam anxiety, perfectionism, and pressure to succeed. Can lead to dropout and mental health crises.

issues.name: Unemployment Depression (Ma1)
issues.description: Depression resulting from unemployment and economic hardship. Associated with loss of identity, social status, and purpose. Widespread in high-unemployment contexts.

issues.name: Substance-Induced Mood Disorder
issues.description: Mood disturbances directly caused by substance use or withdrawal. Can mimic depression, anxiety, or bipolar disorder.

issues.name: Cultural & Spiritual Distress
issues.description: Distress arising from cultural value conflicts, spiritual crises, or disconnection from traditional practices. Often manifests as somatic or emotional symptoms.
